properties.name: Lekki Phase 1 Luxury Shortlet
properties.description: Modern 3-bedroom apartment in the heart of Lekki Phase 1. Features contemporary furnishings, fully equipped kitchen, and 24-hour security. Walking distance to bars, restaurants, and the Lekki-Ikoyi link bridge.

properties.name: Victoria Island Executive Suites
properties.description: Premium serviced apartments on the VI business corridor. Ideal for corporate travellers and extended stays. Each unit comes with a dedicated workspace, blackout curtains, and daily housekeeping.

properties.name: Ikoyi Waterfront Residences
properties.description: Luxury waterfront apartments overlooking Five Cowrie Creek. Each unit has a private balcony with unobstructed water views, smart home controls, and access to a rooftop terrace.

properties.name: Abuja Central Business Hotel
properties.description: Full-service hotel minutes from the National Assembly and major ministries. Conference facilities for up to 200 guests, airport shuttle, and a multi-cuisine restaurant on site.

properties.name: Wuse 2 Corporate Guesthouse
properties.description: Quiet and well-maintained guesthouse in Wuse 2. Popular with NGO staff and government contractors. Includes a shared lounge, fully equipped kitchen, and secure parking.

properties.name: Ikeja GRA Serviced Apartments
properties.description: Well-appointed serviced apartments in the prestigious Ikeja GRA. Close to the Murtala Muhammed Airport and major corporate offices. Suitable for both short and long stays.

properties.name: Port Harcourt Garden Court Hotel
properties.description: Tranquil hotel set within a landscaped garden compound in Trans-Amadi. Favoured by oil and gas executives. Includes a full-service spa, outdoor pool, and fine dining restaurant.

properties.name: Asokoro Diplomatic Guesthouse
properties.description: Exclusive guesthouse serving the diplomatic community in Asokoro. Fully staffed with a cook, steward, and security detail. Discretion and privacy guaranteed.

properties.name: Oniru Beachfront Shortlet
properties.description: Stylish 2-bedroom apartment a 5-minute walk from Oniru Private Beach. Contemporary interiors with ocean-inspired decor, a sun deck, and a fully stocked minibar on arrival.

properties.name: Calabar Heritage Guesthouse
properties.description: Charming colonial-era guesthouse in old Calabar town. Restored to modern comfort while retaining original hardwood floors and wide verandas. Great base for visiting the Cross River National Park.

properties.name: Maitama Prestige Shortlet
properties.description: 5-bedroom fully detached luxury home in Maitama available for shortlet. Comes with a private cinema room, rooftop lounge, outdoor barbecue, and a dedicated facility manager.

properties.name: Enugu Independence Layout Hotel
properties.description: Mid-scale hotel in the upscale Independence Layout district. Clean, reliable, and consistently rated for its exceptional customer service. Shuttle service to Akanu Ibiam Airport included.

properties.name: Surulere Compact Shortlet
properties.description: Affordable and modern studio apartment in Surulere. Ideal for solo travellers, freelancers, and creatives. Close to the National Stadium, Adeniran Ogunsanya Mall, and good road links.

properties.name: Kano City Centre Guesthouse
properties.description: Well-established guesthouse near Kano State Government House. Reliable power supply, strong WiFi, and proximity to Mallam Aminu Kano International Airport make it a preferred choice for business travellers.

properties.name: Banana Island Ultra Luxury Villa
properties.description: Unmatched luxury on Banana Island. This 6-bedroom fully staffed villa includes an infinity pool, home automation system, private jetty, and a Porsche Cayenne available for guest use.

properties.name: Ibadan Premier Business Hotel
properties.description: The most consistently rated business hotel in Ibadan. Conference centre, co-working space, and broadband internet. Located on Ring Road minutes from major Ibadan commercial hubs.

properties.name: Ajah Serene Estate Apartments
properties.description: Gated estate apartments in Ajah. New build with high-end finishes, smart locks, and estate-wide fibre internet. Compound amenities include a mini-mart, gym, and children's play area.

properties.name: Jos Plateau Highlands Retreat
properties.description: Cool-climate guesthouse on the Plateau offering a rare escape from Lagos and Abuja heat. Stone-walled rooms, open fireplaces, and farm-to-table breakfast. Perfect for weekend retreats.
